controller_rss.measurement_scope: sampled controller RSS peak, not cluster memory or allocation bound

decision.c1_p99: Observed +12.8746%; original protocol has no p99 gate
decision.c8: Throughput -2.2104%, p95 +6.2838%, controller CPU/call -0.9358%; all within frozen gates
decision.observation_improvement: No stable throughput or tail-latency improvement established by this finite ABBA
decision.pair_warning: C8 and C16 paired throughput directions disagree; C8 first-pair p95 >1.10 is diagnostic, not a gate
decision.remaining: Normal lifecycle gate and any required final evidence/CI closure remain separate; async read supplement descriptive only
decision.resource_effect: Pooled sampled peak RSS -168 KiB; small controller CPU reductions; descriptive only

frozen_thresholds.cache_cap_evidence_scope: source and qualification; RSS gate measures the actual process
frozen_thresholds.rss_aggregation: maximum sampled controller RSS across all four native controllers per arm, including restarts
frozen_thresholds.rss_combination: both limits; B <= min(A + 512 KiB, A * 1.05)

limitations: Only three downloaded JSON receipts and unchanged local policy sources were reviewed. The 3,541,846-byte native report and its transport/resource trace files were not available in this review.

No independent rehash/replay of wire frames, raw latency samples, synchronous CPU ticks, frozen job results, boundary/canary reports or compiler ledger was performed here; their original auditor verdicts and identities were checked for receipt consistency only.
Source and binary immutability, native terminal, process absence, topology, and allocator settings are linked original report assertions, not fresh remote observations by this reviewer.
Two rounds per arm do not establish statistical significance; no confidence interval or historic pooling is claimed.
RSS is sampled controller memory, not total cluster memory. Resource traces retain missing/process-exit/permission observations; sampler_error=null does not mean every process metric was available.
Percentile ratios are checked from reported percentiles. C8 paired p95 values are retained as reported because per-round percentile samples/denominators are not present in the downloaded analysis.

method.cpu_per_call_ms: 1000 * sum same-controller CPU seconds / sum measured calls
method.numerical_consistency_tolerance: math.isclose(rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-9); strict original thresholds for gates
method.percentiles: Cross-report values and ratios checked; raw latency order statistics not recomputed
method.pooled_rps: sum measured calls / sum measured wall seconds
method.round_reconstruction: 192 measured calls per round; derive seconds and CPU from per-round rates

secondary_reviewer.scope: Independent read-only aggregate/ratio/gate/RSS review of the same three receipts; no raw re-audit
